extra.message: CSV formula injection in report exports — Formula injection executing in a manager's/admin's spreadsheet, enabling data exfiltration or command execution on their workstation. [verified: Unauthenticated /register stores attacker-chosen full_name with only .strip() (auth.py:88), and csv_response (reports.py:35-48) writes these values verbatim via csv.DictWriter with no neutralization of leading =,+,-,@; the values reach manager/admin rent-roll and maintenance exports as the tenant column. Classic CSV formula injection executing in the staff's spreadsheet.]

Session cookie missing Secure flag — Session token interceptable over HTTP, allowing session hijacking. [verified: backend/app/security.py:63 hardcodes secure=False in response.set_cookie for the session token, so the 12h session cookie is transmitted over plaintext HTTP and interceptable by a network MITM; this is not config-driven and no other control enforces TLS-only cookies.]
